content: {"episode_id":"ep-05024","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"This appeal concerns the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for a patient with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Per the clinical indication note, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes. The payer letter states that precertification was not obtained before services were rendered; authorization status is missing, and this appeal is submitted with the clinical documentation supporting medical necessity as the letter invites."}
